facts.field: historical definition of a healthy diet
facts.value: more than 55% carbohydrates, less than 30% fat, about 15% proteins

facts.field: current definition of healthful dietary pattern
facts.value: a diet consisting predominantly of fruits, vegetables, legumes, nuts, seeds, plant protein and fatty fish with reduced consumption of saturated fat, salt and ultra-processed food
facts.programme_association: Healthy Lifestyles and Fitness Science Degree

facts.field: National Heart Foundation of Australia's Healthy Eating Principles
facts.value: plenty of fruit, vegetables and whole grains with a variety of protein sources such as fish and seafood, lean poultry with a restriction on red meat
facts.programme_association: Healthy Lifestyles and Fitness Science Degree

facts.field: impact of lack of a healthy diet
facts.value: contributes massively to the global disease burden, imposing immense health, economic and social costs
